1.explanation_zh: 「對於愛追劇的人來說」用 For those who love binge-watching（those who + 複數動詞）。「無論要多早起床」是讓步子句 no matter how early they have to get up，how early 要連在一起，後面用直述句語序。「下一集總是很難抗拒」寫 the next episode is always hard to resist；hard to resist 的不定詞用主動，不寫 to be resisted。
1.strategy_zh: 「對…的人來說」用 For those who …；「無論多＋形容詞」用 no matter how + adj. + S + V。
hints: 切成四段：對於愛追劇（binge-watching）的人來說／無論要多早起床／下一集／總是很難抗拒
標的詞彙：love（熱愛）、early（早）、get up（起床）、next（下一個）、episode（一集）、hard（困難的）、resist（抗拒）
句型框架：For those who + V …, no matter how early + S + have to V, S + is always hard to resist.

2.explanation_zh: 「花整個週末看」是 spend the whole weekend watching（spend + 時間 + V-ing）。「由串流平台推出的影集」修飾語在前，英文改成過去分詞片語後位修飾 series released by streaming platforms（影集是被推出的）。「這讓他們幾乎沒時間到戶外走走」的「這」指前面整件事，用 , which leaves them almost no time to go outdoors；「幾乎沒有」是 almost no／hardly any，outdoors 是副詞，前面不加 to。
evidence: 由串流平台推出的影集
這讓他們幾乎沒時間到戶外走走
2.strategy_zh: 「由…推出／製作的＋名詞」先想「名詞＋p.p.＋by …」；「…，這讓…」指前面整件事時用 , which …。
hints: 切成四段：許多人花整個週末看／由串流平台推出的影集／這讓他們／幾乎沒時間到戶外走走
標的詞彙：spend（花時間）、weekend（週末）、watch（觀看）、release（推出）、streaming（串流）、platform（平台）、series（影集）、almost（幾乎）、time（時間）、outdoors（到戶外）
句型框架：S + spend + 時間 + V-ing + N + p.p. + by …, which leaves + O + almost no time to VR.

bonus.text: So hooked are many viewers on series released by streaming platforms that they hardly set foot outdoors all weekend.
bonus.explanation_zh: So + adj. + are + S + that … 是倒裝的「如此…以致於…」；be hooked on（迷上）、set foot outdoors（踏出戶外）是進階搭配。這是加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

2.notes_zh: 評分說明：「許多人花整個週末看」Many people spend (would spend) the whole／entire weekend（all weekend）watching；「由串流平台推出的影集」(TV) series／shows／dramas + released／launched／put out／offered by (on) streaming platforms，寫成完整的關係子句 series that are released by …／series that streaming platforms release 也算達成本句 PART 標的；「這讓他們」, which leaves (gives) them …、, which means (that) they have …，寫成句尾分詞 , leaving them … 也算達成本句 NRREL 標的；「幾乎沒時間到戶外走走」almost no／hardly any／barely any／little time + to go outdoors／to go outside／to go out (for a walk)／to take a walk outside、for outdoor activities。另外也給分：their entire weekend、whole weekends；, which means (that) they hardly (barely) have time to go outside／go out for a walk。

2.translation: Many people spend their entire weekends watching series released by streaming platforms, which leaves them hardly any time to go outside for a walk.
2.explanation_zh: 「花整個週末看」用 spend … V-ing；「由串流平台推出的影集」用過去分詞 released by 後位修飾；「這讓他們幾乎沒時間」用 , which leaves them hardly any time to V；「到戶外走走」譯 go outside for a walk。

1.translation: For people who love binge-watching, the next episode is always hard to resist, no matter how early they have to get up.
1.explanation_zh: 「對於愛追劇的人來說」用 For people who love binge-watching；「下一集總是很難抗拒」用 the next episode is always hard to resist；「無論要多早起床」用 no matter how early they have to get up（也可用 however early）。

2.translation: Many people spend the whole weekend watching series released by streaming platforms, which leaves them with almost no time to go out for a walk.
2.explanation_zh: 「花整個週末看……」用 spend the whole weekend watching ...；「由串流平台推出的影集」用過去分詞片語 released by streaming platforms 後置修飾 series（series 單複數同形）；「這讓他們幾乎沒時間……」用 which leaves them with almost no time to ...；「到戶外走走」不確定用 go outdoors 或 go out for a walk 哪個較貼近，所以信心為 medium。
